name: Identity Verification & Civil Status
summary: Official government-issued documents used to verify a client's legal identity, nationality, age, and civil or marital status for KYC compliance.
examples: Social Security Card / National Insurance Card
Divorce Decree / Final Judgment of Dissolution

name: Proof of Address & Residency
summary: Documents confirming a client's current residential address and domicile for regulatory, tax residency, and AML verification.
examples: Internet, Landline, or Cable TV Bill
Bank or Credit Card Statement Showing Residential Address
Homeowner's or Renter's Insurance Policy Declaration Page
Official Tax Assessment Notice Showing Address

name: Income & Source of Wealth Verification
summary: Evidence demonstrating how a client earns regular income and how their overall net worth or investable capital was accumulated.
examples: Stock Option / RSU / Equity Grant Agreement
Share Purchase or Business Sale / Exit Agreement (SPA)
M&A Closing Statement / Liquidity Event Proof
Inheritance Distribution Letter or Grant of Probate
Gift Deed / Notarized Letter of Gift
Royalty, Licensing, or Patent Income Statement
Pension or Social Security Award Letter
Audited Company Financial Statements for Business Owners

name: Tax Filings & Regulatory Tax Reporting
summary: Domestic and international tax returns, annual income statements, and cross-border tax compliance certifications.
examples: Wage and Tax Statement (Form W-2, P60, P45)
Foreign Status & Withholding Certificates (Form W-8BEN, W-8BEN-E, W-9)
Foreign Bank and Financial Accounts Report (FBAR / FinCEN Form 114)
Gift and Estate Tax Return (Form 706, Form 709)

name: Banking, Treasury & Cash Flow
summary: Records of liquid cash holdings, bank accounts, money market deposits, wire transfers, and proof of funds.
examples: Certificate of Deposit (CD) / Fixed Term Deposit Confirmation
Proof of Funds / Bank Comfort Letter

name: Public Market Investments & Brokerage
summary: Statements and trade records for publicly traded securities, custodial accounts, mutual funds, ETFs, and fixed-income holdings.
examples: Monthly or Quarterly Brokerage Account Statement
Fixed Income / Bond Maturity & Coupon Schedule
Mutual Fund & ETF Prospectus / Fact Sheet
Stock Certificate / Direct Registration System (DRS) Advice

name: Private Markets & Alternative Investments
summary: Legal and financial documentation for private equity, venture capital, hedge funds, private credit, crypto, and collectibles.
examples: Quarterly GP / Fund Capital Account Statement (PCAP)
SAFE (Simple Agreement for Future Equity) or Convertible Note
Angel / Venture Cap Table & Share Certificate
Hedge Fund Side Letter & Redemption Request
Digital Asset / Cryptocurrency Custody & Wallet Statement
Art, Wine, or Luxury Collectibles Provenance & Appraisal Certificate

name: Retirement Accounts & Pension Plans
summary: Statements, plan rules, and rollover records for employer-sponsored retirement plans, individual retirement accounts, and pensions.
examples: Traditional, Roth, or SEP IRA Statement
Defined Benefit / Final Salary Pension Annual Statement

name: Estate Planning, Wills & Trusts
summary: Fiduciary and legal instruments governing wealth transfer, succession, guardianship, incapacity, and trust administration.
examples: Irrevocable Trust Deed (GRAT, ILIT, Dynasty Trust, Charitable Remainder Trust)
Healthcare Power of Attorney / Healthcare Proxy
Trustee Appointment, Acceptance, or Resignation Deed

name: Real Estate & Property Holdings
summary: Ownership records, valuations, purchase contracts, and management documents for residential, commercial, and land properties.
examples: Property Title Deed / Land Registry Extract
Real Estate Purchase and Sale Agreement
Independent Real Estate Appraisal / Valuation Report
Commercial or Residential Lease Agreement (Landlord Income)

name: Loans, Mortgages & Liabilities
summary: Contracts and statements for personal or structured borrowing, mortgages, lines of credit, and debt obligations.
examples: Home Equity Line of Credit (HELOC) Statement
Securities-Backed Line of Credit (SBLOC) / Lombard Loan Agreement
Auto, Aviation, or Yacht Financing Agreement
Loan Payoff Letter / Lien Release Certificate

name: Insurance Policies & Annuities
summary: Contracts and policy schedules covering life, health, disability, property, casualty, umbrella liability, and annuity products.
examples: Term or Whole Life Insurance Policy Schedule
Universal or Variable Life Insurance In-Force Illustration
Fixed or Variable Annuity Contract & Statement
Homeowners, Auto, and Valuable Articles (Fine Art / Jewelry) Policy
Directors and Officers (D&O) or Key Person Insurance Policy

name: Corporate, Family Office & Entity Governance
summary: Formation, ownership, and governance documents for LLCs, holding companies, partnerships, family offices, and SPVs.
examples: Articles of Incorporation / Certificate of Formation
Corporate Bylaws or LLC Operating Agreement
Register of Directors and Beneficial Owners (UBO Register)
Certificate of Good Standing / Incumbency Certificate
Power of Representation / Authorized Signatory List

name: Philanthropy, Foundations & Charitable Giving
summary: Records relating to donor-advised funds, private family foundations, charitable trusts, and tax-deductible donations.
examples: Donor-Advised Fund (DAF) Account Statement & Grant Confirmation
Private Family Foundation Charter & IRS 501(c)(3) Determination Letter

name: Advisory Agreements, Compliance & Financial Plans
summary: Advisor-client contracts, regulatory disclosures, suitability profiles, and holistic financial planning deliverables.
examples: Accredited Investor / Qualified Purchaser / Professional Client Certification
AML / KYC Onboarding & PEP Screening Dossier
Form ADV / Fee Schedule & Conflict of Interest Disclosure
Comprehensive Financial Plan & Cash Flow Projection
Discretionary Trading & Custodial Limited Power of Attorney (LPOA)

name: Other / Miscellaneous Documents
summary: Unclassified, bespoke, or general correspondence documents that do not fit into standard wealth management, KYC, tax, legal, or investment categories.
examples: Educational Certificates, Diplomas, or CV / Resume
